The structure of epitope-specific P-4G2 Fab in complex with PUUV virus-like particles (VLPs) was analyzed by cryo-EM at 13. 4 Å resolution. The data were split in two sets: (i) spikes that were part of a lattice, and (ii) spikes in regions of incomplete lattice. The former yielded a reconstruction similar to the VLP sample prepared without the Fab, while the reconstruction focused on lattice-free spikes yielded a discrete (Gn Gc)4 spike with additional density. These results suggest that mAb P-4G2 binding is incompatible with glycoprotein lattice formation, and that Fab P-4G2 binding may affect the higher order lattice assembly.
